remarks: Quiet, Spacious and Bright 2 bedroom, 1 bath apartment on the second floor of a well kept multi-family. Large sunny Living Room and Formal dining room. Updated eat in Kitchen with good counter space. Laundry Room with Washer and Dryer off the Kitchen. Good sized storage room in the basement with ample shelving. Two off street reserved parking spaces which are #2 and #3 as you face the large level communal back yard. Easy access to buses, shops, restaurants and I-95. The convenient Glenbrook Train Station is only a short walk away. No smoking or pets. 2 months security deposit. Owner reserves the right to meet the tenant. 720+ fico score required. All documents must be presented in one PDF. Photos are from the prior listing.
